description: This script is a test suite for filesystem-related features in Git, including case sensitivity, symlink support, Unicode normalization, and repository state validation. It configures test environment variables, performs various filesystem operations, and verifies Git behavior across different filesystem configurations.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks if a specific prerequisite (like UTF8_NFD_TO_NFC) is available for testing.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Sets up a new repository for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test suite.
